title: lithocarpus havilandii
intro: Lithocarpus havilandii, commonly known as the Borneo Bur oak, is a species of evergreen tree in the beech family, Fagaceae. The Borneo Bur oak is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to the prevention of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus havilandii include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and act as a protective agent against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
